subject: Urgent: p99 latency + 503 surge on QuantumEdge private cluster — exec escalation requested
messages:
From: Lina Park <lina.park@quantumedge.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, QuantumEdge Support <support@quantumedge.com>
Date: Tue, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Production: p99 latency spike + 503s on QE-edge VPC

Hi Vanessa,

We're seeing a sustained p99 CPU/latency spike and ~4-6% 503 error rate across our on-prem inference cluster (QE-edge, tenant: quantumedge-prod) since ~08:55 PDT. Traffic pattern hasn't changed from our side; request rates are steady. Impact: several business-critical endpoints are timing out for downstream workflows — our ops team has paged the engineering leadership.

Key observations so far:
- p50: 90ms, p95: 320ms, p99: 3.1s (previous baseline p99 ~600ms)
- 503s concentrated on model-serving pods that are pinned to GPU pool 3
- No config change from our deployment pipeline since yesterday
- Attached: qe_log_summary.csv (top error stacks, sample request ids)

We need immediate assistance and an update for our CTO (Samir). Can you confirm next steps and whether you can open a remediation bridge?

Thanks,
Lina Park
Platform Ops — QuantumEdge Health
[attachment: qe_log_summary.csv (text/csv)]

Subject: Re: Production: p99 latency spike + 503s on QE-edge VPC

Lina — thanks for the quick signal and the log summary. I'm on it.

Immediate plan (30m):
- Open an emergency Zoom bridge (joining now) and pinging our on-call infra team.
- Request: please preserve a 30-second trace/sample for request id QE-REQ-* (we'll correlate).
- Short mitigations to try while we triage:
  1) Temporarily reduce max_batch_size and lower max_tokens per request on the public route to reduce tail latency.
  2) Enable sticky KV cache (if not already) for the tenant to reduce repeated KV miss overhead.
  3) If throughput remains high, consider falling back to the quantized model variant (same family) as a short-term relief.

I've looped in Karthik (SE, infra tuning) and Monica (engineering lead) to validate and run runbook steps. Will post updates to this thread and to the bridge.

-Vanessa

Subject: Re: Production: p99 latency spike + 503s on QE-edge VPC

Joining the bridge — quick triage notes from infra: we see a sharp rise in kernel sched wait on a subset of GPU nodes and increased RPC queue depth on the serving frontends. Likely contributors and immediate mitigations: 

1) Hot mitigation (apply now):
   - Reduce max_batch_size by 40% on the affected route(s) to prevent head-of-line blocking.
   - Force sticky KV cache for tenant id quantumedge-prod for 15 minutes and monitor hit-rate.
   - Trigger a local model-variant fallback to the q4_0_quant (quantized) profile for low-latency traffic routes.

2) Mid-term (under 2 hours):
   - Rebalance model shards away from GPU pool 3 (drain and reschedule) — nodes show uneven CUDA memory pressure.
   - Apply a kernel-level small patch (net/transport tuned) to reduce kernel-level spin in our RPC path (patch ID: rwd-kernel-patch-20270510).

3) Ask for logs:
   - Per-request traces for three sample request ids (attached in Lina's CSV) and full nvprof snapshots from the affected nodes.

I'll attach our surge runbook checklist; if this relieves the pain we can roll a controlled rollout of the quantized variant.

[attachment: redwood_surge_checklist.pdf]

—Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
